reviews.title: Awesome Looking Case With Great Airflow and Tons of Fans Included
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1eIcT9HfuL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71dzXqp4LpL._SY256.jpg This MUSETEX Y6 case is a really strong value, especially if you want a clean showcase-style gaming PC without having to buy a bunch of extra fans separately.
The biggest thing customers should know is that the case looks way better in person than a basic mid tower. The 270° tempered glass gives the build a full-view display look, and the included infinity mirror ARGB fans make it feel premium right out of the box. Having 7 pre-installed PWM ARGB fans is a huge plus because it saves money, saves setup time, and gives the case solid airflow from the start.
Building in it is pretty straightforward. There is enough room for an ATX build, cable management is manageable, and the Type-C front panel port is a nice modern feature. Once everything is powered on, the RGB looks sharp without needing much extra work.
A couple things to keep in mind: because this is a glass-heavy case, you’ll want to spend a little time on cable management so the build looks clean. Also, double-check your GPU length, cooler height, and motherboard connections before building, just like with any case.
Overall, this is a great pick for someone who wants a flashy, modern gaming PC case with good airflow, lots of fans included, and a premium display-style look without spending crazy money. 🔥
reviews.author: Kevin A.

reviews.title: A good choice for a good PC
reviews.comment: Great case. Excellent cable management options. It accommodates large graphics cards and 360mm liquid cooling systems. The rear panel is designed to allow cables to be routed without tension. The fans with adjustable lighting are quiet, and there are enough of them to keep the beer inside the case cool in the summer. I was very pleased with the price of the case. Great visibility through the glass panel and an excellent overall look; in fact, the case isn’t bulky at all. I recommend it. A good choice for a good PC.
reviews.author: Alex M.

reviews.title: Looks Great! Easy to Install!
reviews.comment:
Pros: This case comes with fans, which I find as a great add on for the value. The size is perfect, the motherboard is easy to install coming with clear instructions, and it functions well.👍
Cons: The wire management space in the back is limited so some people may have trouble routing cables.
Would I recommend? Definitely! I love the fish tank design which is aesthetically appealing and how everything was easy to install.
reviews.author: John and Family

reviews.title: CHEAP hardware included
reviews.comment:
I considered giving this 3 stars, but for the price it’s passable for 4. The case itself is beautiful and the overall design is functional. The wire tuck ability is there if you take the time. There is a single HDD/SSD bay above the PSU slot.
Major con with this is the extremely terrible hardware included. The standoffs that are pre-installed won’t even accept the standard screw or any of the screws that were sent in the box. I had to plier out the standoffs and reinstall my own brass standoffs and use my own screws. I have built 50+ computers in my career and have never seen standoffs and hardware so bad. I was lucky to have extra hardware to replace what was given. For the money this is a pretty nice case, especially if you can get a deal on it.
reviews.author: Sterling
